title: Aspect Ratio
description: A box that holds its shape — 16/9 for video, 4/3 for photos, 1/1 for avatars — whatever fills it.
usage: For media slots whose content arrives late or varies: embeds, thumbnails, covers. The layout never jumps because the shape was reserved first.
a11y: Pure CSS — the aspect-ratio property does the work, so there is nothing to announce and nothing to break. Put the alt text on the media inside, as usual.
